name: gallery-modal-accordion
title: Gallery Modal Accordion
blurb: Accordion gallery with modal expansion for full-screen image viewing.
description: An AccordionModal using Framer Motion; displays horizontal image accordion that expands to full-screen on click with title and description.
use_when: Showcasing image galleries with compact accordion view that expands to immersive full-screen detail.
avoid_when: For simple image grids without accordion behavior — use a plain gallery layout instead.
a11y: Keyboard Escape closes modal; images are clickable; hover/tap states indicate interactivity; body overflow locked when expanded.
